"""One safe local collector feeding three read-only cards."""

from datetime import timedelta
from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

from scryr import (
    Collector,
    Command,
    Diagram,
    Every,
    HistoryCard,
    JsonOutput,
    Manifest,
    StatusCard,
    TableCard,
    Task,
)


class DeploymentSnapshot(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", strict=True)

    version: str
    state: Literal["healthy", "degraded"]
    ready_instances: int = Field(ge=0)


api = Manifest(name="API", manifest_id="collectors-api")
deployment = Task[DeploymentSnapshot](
    id="deployment-status",
    command=Command(
        argv=["printf", "%s", '{"version":"demo-v1","state":"healthy","ready_instances":3}']
    ),
    output=JsonOutput(model=DeploymentSnapshot),
)
production = Collector[DeploymentSnapshot](
    id="api-deployment",
    task=deployment,
    schedule=Every(timedelta(seconds=30)),
)
status = StatusCard[DeploymentSnapshot](
    id="deployment", title="Deployment", source=production, target=api
)
details = TableCard[DeploymentSnapshot](
    id="deployment-details", title="Deployment details", source=production, target=api
)
history = HistoryCard[DeploymentSnapshot](
    id="deployment-history", title="Deployment history", source=production, target=api
)

diagram = Diagram(name="Local collectors", manifests=[api])

    name="MERN Forge",
    description="Node.js toolchain, environment, and common developer tasks for the MERN sample.",
    tools={
        "node": ForgeTool(version="22", postinstall="corepack enable"),
        "mongodb": "8",
        "redis": "7",
    },
    env={
        "NODE_ENV": "development",
        "MONGO_URL": "mongodb://localhost:27017/mern",
        "REDIS_URL": "redis://localhost:6379",
    },
    vars={"api_port": 3001, "web_port": 3000},
    tasks={
        "install": ForgeTask(run="npm install"),
        "dev:web": ForgeTask(
            description="Run the React frontend",
            run="npm run dev --workspace web",
            depends="install",
        ),
        "dev:api": ForgeTask(
            description="Run the Express API", run="npm run dev --workspace api", depends="install"

    ],
)
